system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; prompt templates are deferred to Appendix A.1, which is not in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.note: The domain is not a repository. No mechanism for supplying environment context is described.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no configuration surface is available.

observation_format.note: Paper only. The format of observations returned to the LLM is not described.

tool_call_format.note: Built on LangGraph, but the paper does not state which tool-call syntax is used.

tool_count.note: No tool registry is available. The paper describes agents (planning, generative, prediction, optimization, physics, knowledge), not tool schemas.

edit_primitive.note: Not a file-editing system; no tool registry is available.

protocol_standardization.note: The paper mentions RESTful APIs between the front end and back end. No agent protocol is discussed, and no code is available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The task planning agent interprets user intent and decomposes it into a dynamically executable workflow.
loop_primitives.note: The optimization agent loop iterates prompt, then evaluation, then feedback until convergence (Sec. 3.5, Table 2). It is built on a LangGraph supervisor graph.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: It combines semantic understanding with rule-based matching to convert user requests into structured task sequences.
planning_granularity.note: The structured task sequence and execution pipeline (Fig. 5) are inferred to be a stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The proposed framework adopts a supervisor -based architecture. A high- level planning agent is responsible for global task scheduling and decomposes complex turbomachinery aerodynamic design problems into multiple subtasks.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: It can also selectively invoke the compressor design agent, performance prediction agent, and optimization agent at appropriate stages.
delegation_mechanism.note: This is LangGraph node routing within a shared graph. Closest value is role_handoff.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: After completion, the agent prompts the user for post-processing. Upon confirmation, it automatically generates a script compatible with ANSYS CFX-Post
human_in_loop.note: The paper also states that human feedback can be introduced as external input (Sec. 3.1.1).

short_term_state.note: The LangGraph state is not described.

long_term_memory.note: A compressor database exists as training data. It is not agent memory.

self_verification.evidence_quote: After optimization, candidate designs are further validated through high- fidelity physical simulations, including CFD simulation s and structural strength analysis.
self_verification.note: Closest value: the physics-simulation verification (CFD/FEA) and surrogate evaluation are domain verifiers, not software tests.

retry_policy.note: The optimization iterations are an algorithm, not task-level retries.

termination_condition.note: Only the optimizer's inner convergence criterion (Table 2) is described, not run termination.

cost_controls.note: Token consumption is measured (Sec. 4.4), but no budget control is described.

tracing.note: The front-end visualization and generated design reports are not traces.

target_domain.evidence_quote: TurboAgent, a large language model (LLM)-driven autonomous multi-agent framework for turbomachinery aerodynamic design and optimization.

open_source.note: No repository URL is given. Data is available on request only.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: By leveraging different LLM APIs, the agent interprets natural language inputs provided by the user.
model_agnostic.note: Experiments use the DeepSeek V3.2-Chat API.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: TurboAgent is built on the LangGraph framework (LangChain Team, 2024)
primary_artifact.note: No repository is provided; coded from arXiv:2604.06747.

first_release_date.note: The paper v1 date is not in the evidence. The arXiv id suggests April 2026.

pinned_version.note: No repository is available. The paper is arXiv:2604.06747.
